description: Drop your bags in this charming duplex, steps from the Seine and Île Saint-Louis. 160 sqm bathed in light, where herringbone parquet creaks softly and marble fireplaces whisper old Paris. 4 bedrooms (3 Queen beds, 1 King), a cosy living room, a welcoming dining room, a separate kitchen and an office to unwind. 2 bathrooms, balcony. Sully-Morland metro right at the door, the Marais on your doorstep. Welcome home. Up to 8 guests.The space✨ YOUR PARISIAN HIDEAWAY BY THE SEINEPicture it: you step through the door of a Haussmann building, climb a few stairs, and 160 sqm of warmth open up before you. We designed this duplex to feel like a real home — the kind where you settle in from the very first minute. Two floors linked by a beautiful curved wooden staircase, herringbone parquet underfoot, high ceilings, mouldings and marble fireplaces that give every room its soul. Here, you live Paris like a true Parisian, steps from the river and the Marais.🛋️ LIVING & DINING ROOM — THE HEART OF THE HOMEThis is where everyone comes together. A bright living room with elegant panelling and a panoramic fresco that invites you to daydream, a plush sofa you'll happily sink into, travertine coffee tables and a Smart TV for quiet evenings. Right next door, the dining room seats up to 8 around a large oak table beneath a gilded mirror — the perfect spot to share a good dinner after a day exploring Paris.🍳 THE KITCHEN — MADE FOR GOOD FOODA proper separate kitchen, fully equipped, with its gorgeous cast-iron range cooker that makes you want to cook.
